description: Phase 2 - F-prefixed files (F4211, F0101) and 2-char column prefixes (SDDOCO). This pack is a placeholder; enabling it currently changes nothing.
join_notes: JD Edwards prefixes physical columns with a two-character table code (F4211.SDDOCO, F4311.PDDOCO), so these bare names match a normalised mart extract, not a raw F-file extract. Against raw files they are inert until the prefix stripping in record_prefixes covers this ERP.
